QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Strait Talk Express
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1201000##k wants you to investigate the rising sea level and shattered glaciers. Talk to Puro in Penguin Port to get to the Riena Strait. Talk to #b#p1510000##k once you get there.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p1201000##k sent you to You talked to #b#p1510000##k in #b#m141000000##k to begin investigating the rising sea levels and glaciers.

0.0: We really didn't think it was a problem at first, but then the water just kept getting higher and higher. Soon, all of Rien will be underwater!
0.1: #fNpc/1510000.img/stand/0# #fNpc/1510002.img/stand/0# #fNpc/1510005.img/stand/0#\r\nAll the creatures of Rien are working together now... #bThe Penguins, the Malamutes, and the Seals#k... They used to fight all the time, but they've put aside their differences.
0.2: They've taken to studying the islands that were most affected. Nobody knows what's causing it yet, but I think they're close.
0.3: They could use your help. You'll find them along the #e#bRiena Strait#k#n, if you want to get involved...

yes.0: You need to take a boat to get to Riena Strait. There's a penguin named #b#p1510000##k at #b#m141000000##k that can take you there.\r\n#b(Walk east to #ePenguin Port#n and take the boat to Riena Strait.)#k

no.0: Are you really going to turn aside a request for help? What kind of hero are you?

1.0: I ask for help from #b#p1201000##k, and she sends me this?! Tiny sardine with giant head?!

yes.0: Oh, but I am rude! I am #b#p1510000##k, strongest penguin there is. You must be brave warrior to come across glacier in this weather.

npc.0: Talk to #b#p1511001##k at the Penguin Port to get to Riena Strait. When you arrive at the Glacial Observatory, look for #b#p1510000##k. He's... a character.
